rationale: The claude plan fixes both the turn-keyed and live unkeyed Codex paths with one helper whose rule is fully decidable from ActionTurn fields, keeps fallback-class tool evidence non-exact, and needs no new files; its review findings are small corrections (add the docs/analytics.md paragraph, let a stopless last sibling own samples within its phase bound, and limit equal-start rejection to competing owners), whereas muse leaves live unkeyed tokens partial and codex promotes custom_tool_call records to exact through an under-specified phase-group rule.
